title: Descending range() includes the end bound
statement: The module `src/range.mjs` exports `range(start, end, step = 1)`, which must return an array with the numbers from `start` (inclusive) up to `end` (EXCLUSIVE), advancing by `step`. `step` may be negative (descending sequence). `step === 0` must throw `RangeError`. If the sequence is empty (for example `start === end`), it returns `[]`. Users report that descending sequences are including the `end` value. Fix the module.

bugs.summary: descending loop condition uses >= instead of >
